name: writ
description: Authoring support for Writ — model a rule-governed world; get every consequence back, with the route — over .writ models, .claims question files and .rules derivations: diagnostics, outline, hover and completion, served by the language's own OCaml server.

writ.serverPath.markdownDescription:
Path to the `writ-lsp` language server executable.

A **relative** path is resolved against each open workspace folder, so the default finds the server built by `make build` in a checkout of the writ repository. If no workspace folder has it, `writ-lsp` is looked up on `PATH` — which is what an opam pin of writ or a release tarball provides, and is how this extension works without a checkout.

An **absolute** path is used exactly as given and nothing else is tried.
